title: Stereotype
description: A typed marker that adds virtual attributes and default property values.

key.description: The immutable kebab-case key that elements list in stereotypes.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

group.description: A label, not a link: an element carries at most one stereotype of a group, its own and implied ones together (MQ2013).

requires.description: Stereotype keys an element that carries this one must also carry (MQ2014).

conflicts.description: Stereotype keys an element that carries this one must not carry (MQ2015).

implies.description: Stereotype keys applied with this one, one level deep: an element that carries it carries them too, before its own stereotypes (MQ2017 refuses a stereotype that implies one that implies others).

parameters.description: Typed parameters, shaped like an extension file: a JSON Schema per property name (x-ref and x-translatable included) and the names each carrier must have. Values stay in the element's properties; defaults live in defaultProperties (MQ2018, MQ2019).

properties.description: A JSON Schema properties object: one schema per parameter name.

required.description: The parameters each carrier must have, judged on its merged values (the stereotype's defaults count).

defaultProperties.description: Default property values, merged under each carrier's own properties; each is checked against its own schema in parameters, without required (MQ2018).

storage.description: Table storage parameters the stereotype gives every table that carries it (a reusable tuning profile such as high-churn), per dialect; a table's own storage overrides a parameter, and a later stereotype overrides an earlier one.
